sanskrit_verse: प्रथमे मासि संक्लेदभूतो धातुविमूर्च्छितः । मास्यर्बुदं द्वितीये तु तृतीयेऽङ्गेन्द्रियैर्युतः ॥
transliteration: prathame māsi saṃkledabhūto dhātuvimūrcchitaḥ | māsy arbudaṃ dvitīye tu tṛtīye 'ṅgendriyair yutaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the first month, the fetus is formed through the coagulation of elements; in the second month, it develops into a mass; by the third month, it becomes united with limbs and sense organs.
